description.value: Docksteader Source for Sports is an independently owned member of the national Source for Sports buying group, with over 150 affiliated stores across Canada. Located in Surrey on King George Boulevard, it specializes in hockey, baseball, softball, lacrosse, racquet sports, inline skating, and team merchandise, along with equipment services like skate sharpening, racquet stringing, and glove repair. Touring cyclists may find athletic apparel, footwear, and hydration products here, but the store does not appear to stock cycling-specific equipment or offer bike repair services.
